title: Credit’s Lair — The Golden Offer
status: Production plan; illustrated prototype exists. No video generation has run.
model: Provider-neutral shot prompts, suitable for reference-conditioned generation such as Higgsfield Seedance 2.5. Confirm model availability and settings in the connected account.
style_bible: Original theatrical 2D fantasy animation: hand-painted backgrounds, confident ink contours, expressive comedic acting, rich emerald and amber light against midnight indigo. Match the attached reference artwork. Original young adult knight with tousled brown hair, bronze armor, teal cloak and brown leather belt. Original auburn-mustached merchant in plum robes with gold trim. Original enormous emerald dragon with amber eyes. Keep each character’s identity, proportions, costume and handedness consistent within the sequence. 16:9, 1080p master.
continuity: Use the matching artwork as the location and lighting reference; use merchant.webp as the clearest knight face reference.
Create approved character turnarounds before final multi-shot production.

In cash and credit branches the knight acquires gold armor; downstream final clips need gold/old-armor variants or framing that avoids the breastplate. The current illustrated prototype uses one shared poster per location.

Shots for crossroads and bridge introduce locations and supporting characters absent from the posters: use the provided art as a style reference, not a fixed first frame. Approve those new keyframes before final generation.
Keep the knight moving left to right toward the vault; finish decision shots with a stable neutral pose.
Render clean images. Interface text, exact amounts, subtitles and game controls are added by the engine.
Use ambience and foley only for initial clips. Device narration is provided by the prototype; replace it with finished voice tracks in final production.
Review character continuity, hands, faces, timing, visual readability, and transition frames before accepting any generated clip.
